page_title: LYO 2-0 NIC | Lyon v Nice 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Thomas Leonard is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+3' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Tyler Morton (Lyon).
90+3' Khalis Merah (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lyon.
90+1' Substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles will be replaced by Noham Kamara (Lyon).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) works the corner short.
87' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Thomas Leonard ignores the protests.
87' Tyler Morton (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but Maxime Dupe comes off his line to gather the ball.
86' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ali Abdi (Nice).
84' The resulting corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
83' Substitution. Morgan Sanson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Isak Jansson (Nice).
81' The referee awards a corner and Tyler Morton (Lyon) goes over to take it.
81' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roman Yaremchuk (Lyon) replacing Pavel Sulc.
79' Lyon keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
75' Substitution. Dante makes way for Juma Bah (Nice).
75' Here is a change. Tom Louchet is going off and Claude Puel gives the last tactical orders to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
74' Mohamed-Ali Cho goes off the pitch and Kevin (Nice) comes on.
74' Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range. His poor effort sails well wide of the left post.
71' Kail Boudache (Nice) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
69' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
69' 5:4 – the corner kicks stats.
66' The referee signals a substitution. Khalis Merah (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Corentin Tolisso.
64' 2 - 0 Goal! Noah Nartey (Lyon) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 2:0.
64' One of the Nice players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
63' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Pavel Sulc (Lyon), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post.
62' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Kojo Peprah (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
58' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Kail Boudache (Nice), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
57' 1:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
57' Tyler Morton (Lyon) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
52' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) sees a yellow card from Thomas Leonard after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
51' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.

49' This was a piece of cake for Dominik Greif. Tom Louchet (Nice) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
47' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Thomas Leonard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) for a tough tackle.
45+1' 1 - 0 GOAL! Pavel Sulc meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:0.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Some great controlled play and passing from Lyon. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
42' Kail Boudache (Nice) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
41' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
41' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
37' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Morgan Sanson (Nice) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
35' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maxime Dupe intercepts the ball.
34' That's unlucky! Tyler Morton (Lyon) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

31' Tom Louchet (Nice) receives a pin-point pass in the middle of the pitch which gives him a great opportunity to score. He is unfazed by the distance and slams the ball towards the goal. He is unlucky as he hits one of his own teammates.
28' Tom Louchet (Nice) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Dominik Greif.
27' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) gets his head on the corner, but he sees his header blocked.
27' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

27' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

22' Sofiane Diop (Nice) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Dominik Greif. Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
21' A yellow card is awarded to Morgan Sanson (Nice).
17' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) takes a short corner kick.

16' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' Lyon quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
13' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
12' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
11' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).
10' Free kick. Nice will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
8' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Problems for Claude Puel as Elye Wahi is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Kail Boudache (Nice) replaces him.
5' Elye Wahi (Nice) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
4' Lyon keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
2' Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Nice will kick the game off.
Thomas Leonard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
